key_observations: Northstar Coffee moved through another concrete completion step: the remaining identity and packaging changes were addressed and the handoff package was reviewed.
A new social campaign request consumed a substantial afternoon block and competed directly with the portfolio goal.
The portfolio case study continued to progress, including retrieval of older assets, but it remains unfinished.
The evening personal typography experiment appears to be genuine creative exploration rather than client production, although its value to the broader portfolio is not yet clear.
The day was less dominated by open-ended identity exploration than the previous two days and contained more production and organization work.
Some browsing sessions remain ambiguous and should not automatically be classified as distraction.

priority_alignment.priority: Close the remaining Northstar Coffee deliverables

important_uncertainty: The handoff files were reviewed, but there is not enough evidence to conclude that the client has formally closed the project.
The Pinterest session may have supported the personal typography experiment, but the observed evidence does not establish whether it materially influenced the work.
The YouTube session is ambiguous and should not be labeled productive or distracting without additional evidence.
expected_reflection.possible_next_step: Confirm the final status of the Northstar handoff, then reserve a protected block for completing the portfolio case study before additional small client requests accumulate.

primary_action.title: Finish the portfolio case study
primary_action.reason: The Northstar project has received several days of sustained client attention, while the related portfolio case study has repeatedly received shorter blocks and remains unfinished.

things_not_to_do: Do not assume the social campaign work was an avoidable interruption.
Do not classify the personal typography experiment as wasted time simply because it was not client work.
Do not treat Pinterest browsing as distraction without evidence about its relationship to the experiment.
Do not claim the Northstar project is fully complete unless client approval is observed.
Do not infer motivation, stress, frustration, or confidence from the unfinished portfolio work.
Do not treat file organization as equivalent to creative production, but also do not dismiss it when it supports ongoing work.
